# The first repair cafe ran late

The repair cafe repaired four objects and diagnosed three. One visitor waited an hour for a toaster we eventually refused to open. Explain refusal criteria at intake, not after the queue. The useful success was a child learning to replace a torch battery, which our object tally barely records. [[Repair ideas]] needs an account of learning as well as throughput.
